title: Café membership revamp
subtitle: A brief for the café membership app: decisions first, then flow and impact.

items.title: Stars, not points
items.text: Every yuan spent earns one star; no thresholds, no expiry.

items.title: Three tiers
items.text: Your rolling 90-day total sets silver, gold, or black-gold tiers.

items.title: One-scan checkout
items.text: A single scan earns stars and redeems rewards; it works offline.

items.title: Store value gifts
items.text: Load 200, get 20. Refundable, with the rules on the home page.

items.title: Birthday doubles
items.text: All purchases in the birthday week earn twice the stars.

items.title: Trends, not profiles
items.text: The store dashboard shows trends only, not per-customer profiles.

items.label: Order
items.text: In person at the counter, or in the app.

items.label: Earn
items.text: Stars are credited after one scan.

cells: Paper stamp cards, lost means gone
Stars live in the app, visible forever
One scan covers earning and redemption
Manual membership counts at month end
Live sales trends in the dashboard

sections.title: Risks and dependencies
sections.text: Paper stamp cards convert into the app by the end of October, running in parallel for two weeks. If conversion slips, the new rules start a week later; store events are unchanged.

items.text: A regular earns and redeems stars in a single scan
Tier changes on the 90-day total apply automatically
Baristas record offline; uploads resume on reconnect
Stored value refunds to the original payment method
